description: What a recording must declare before it can be fitted. The rules live HERE, in data; scripts/matlab/cascadeRecordingContract.m only applies them. Kept as an array of records rather than an object keyed by unit because MATLAB's jsondecode mangles field names containing '/'.

sample_interval_s.doc: Raw sampling interval of the stored arrays, in SECONDS. Not the fitting dt.
sample_interval_s.sane_range_note: Outside this band the value is almost always milliseconds or a sample RATE written into the wrong field; both produce a decimation factor that is wrong by orders of magnitude and invisible downstream.

stim_var.doc: Name of the stimulus variable inside the .npz / .mat.

resp_var.doc: Name of the response variable inside the .npz / .mat.

orientation.doc: Declared layout of the stored arrays. Declaring time_x_epochs transposes on load; leaving it at the default and storing the transpose is refused, because the loader cannot tell a transposed 3x60000 from a genuine 60000x3.

response_units.doc: Units of the stored response. Decides rectification AND conversion to canonical.

stimulus_units.doc: Units of the stored stimulus, for the record only. There is NO canonical stimulus unit and nothing is converted: contrast, pixel intensity, R*/cone/s and raw DAC counts are all legitimate, and the fitted filter amplitude absorbs whatever scale was used. Declared so a reader knows what the numbers meant, not so the loader can act on it.

response_scale.doc: Explicit multiplier applied to the response on load. Overrides unit-table conversion; use when response_units is not something the table knows.

conversion_note: Only the RESPONSE is converted, and only within its own dimension -- mV and pA are both canonical and are never converted into each other. A voltage recording stored in V is scaled to mV so that alpha and epsilon come out in the units the diagnostics and the literature assume; leaving it in V shifts them by 1000x and every threshold in the skill silently stops applying. The stimulus is never touched.
rectify_note: Rectification follows the KIND, not the values. Rectifying an analog trace destroys the decrement half of an OFF cell's response; failing to rectify a rate lets the fit spend its dynamic range on negative firing rates. Neither is visible in R^2, which is why the unit is declared rather than guessed.

preprocessing_invariants.rule: mean-subtract the stimulus per epoch; leave the response in native units
preprocessing_invariants.why: the filter absorbs stimulus scale, so removing its mean costs nothing. Normalising the RESPONSE moves alpha and epsilon off the units every threshold in this skill assumes, and nothing in R^2 shows it.

preprocessing_invariants.rule: rectify=false unless response_units is a rate (spikes/s)
preprocessing_invariants.why: rectification follows the declared KIND, never the values. Rectifying an analog trace destroys the decrement half of an OFF cell's response; failing to rectify a rate spends the fit's range on negative firing rates.
preprocessing_invariants.enforced_by: response_units_table.rectify. DECIDED here and reported as info.rectify; NOT applied to the stored response by any loader, in either language port. The stored response is measured data and clipping it would destroy real samples -- the constraint belongs on the model's prediction, which is a modelling choice this contract does not make for you. cascadeLoadEpochs and cascade_fit.load_epochs both raise it as unresolved when it is true, so a rate recording cannot go into a fit that silently ignores it.

preprocessing_invariants.rule: decimate to the fitting dt; 0.1 ms raw to 10 ms bins is factor 100
preprocessing_invariants.why: the factor must be an integer multiple of sample_interval_s. A non-integer factor is refused rather than rounded, because a silently rounded decimation shifts the whole time axis.

preprocessing_invariants.rule: keep the epoch structure as an (epochs x time) matrix; never flatten
preprocessing_invariants.why: per-epoch R^2 is the readout that matters and it cannot be recovered from concatenated epochs. Pooling also credits the model for across-epoch mean differences, which is a different quantity that ranks fits differently.
preprocessing_invariants.enforced_by: orientation + the transposed-array assertion in cascadeLoadEpochs
